Title: Shawn: Q: Exhausting your library and Kherebutu

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
If you've exhausted your library, have Kherebutu in play,
and have fewer cards in you hand than your maximum hand size,

1) When Kherebutu is burned (and goes to your library), does
he immediately pop into you hand? (First impression anser
is 'no', but then...)

2) If 'no', then if you run out of cards in your hand (zero
cards in hand plus zero in the library), and Kherebutu is
burned (and goes to your library), how do you get to draw
him (since you only draw to replace cards that you play)?

3) If 'no' (to question 1), than can you still withdraw?
(The rules require to to have exhausted your library - is
that a one-time event, or a current status? Once exhausted,
can you always then withdraw, even if your library becomes
un-exhausted?)
